Composite figure:
- **(a)** Mediation path diagram (S → CSP1-2 → Shannon) with 88% indirect effect
- **(b)** Non-linear rainfall dose-response (Hill / Spline / GP with 95% credibility bands)
- **(c)** Interventional posteriors forest plot (do(rain+10mm), do(S−1SD), reclamation do(S−2SD, P+1SD))
- **(d)** JSDM keystone knockout — ΔShannon propagation through top-affected genera

```{python}
#| label: setup
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch
from pathlib import Path
mpl.rcParams["font.size"] = 9

REPO = Path("..").resolve()
CACHE = REPO / "cache"
FIG = REPO / "figures"
FIG.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
```

```{python}
#| label: load
med = pd.read_csv(CACHE / "causal_tier1_mediation.tsv", sep="\t")
nonlinear = pd.read_csv(CACHE / "causal_nonlinear_doseresp.tsv", sep="\t")
interv = pd.read_csv(CACHE / "causal_tier3_interventions.tsv", sep="\t")
interv_ex = pd.read_csv(CACHE / "causal_tier3_interventions_expanded.tsv", sep="\t")
knockout = pd.read_csv(CACHE / "jsdm_knockout_shifts.tsv", sep="\t") if (CACHE / "jsdm_knockout_shifts.tsv").exists() else None
print("mediation:", med.to_dict("records")[0])
print()
print("interv head:")
print(interv_ex.head(6))
```

```{python}
#| label: fig
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13, 8.5))
gs = GridSpec(2, 2, figure=fig, hspace=0.32, wspace=0.28, height_ratios=[0.9, 1.0])

# ---------------- (a) Mediation path diagram ----------------
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_a.set_xlim(0, 10); ax_a.set_ylim(0, 10)
ax_a.axis("off")

# Box style
def draw_node(ax, x, y, label, color, w=2.4, h=1.1):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.15",
                         ec="black", fc=color, lw=1.5, alpha=0.92)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(x, y, label, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")

draw_node(ax_a, 1.5, 5, "Salinity (S)", "#fecaca")
draw_node(ax_a, 5, 7.5, "CSP1-2", "#fed7aa")
draw_node(ax_a, 8.5, 5, "Shannon\ndiversity", "#bfdbfe")

# Arrows
a1 = FancyArrowPatch((2.5, 5.35), (4.0, 7.2), arrowstyle="->",
                     connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.18", lw=2.5, color="#b91c1c")
a2 = FancyArrowPatch((6.0, 7.2), (7.5, 5.35), arrowstyle="->",
                     connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.18", lw=2.5, color="#b91c1c")
a3 = FancyArrowPatch((2.7, 4.7), (7.3, 4.7), arrowstyle="->",
                     connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.18", lw=1.2, color="#6b7280", linestyle="--")
for a in [a1, a2, a3]:
    ax_a.add_patch(a)
ax_a.text(3.2, 6.55, r"$-0.29$", color="#b91c1c", fontweight="bold", fontsize=10)
ax_a.text(6.8, 6.55, r"$+0.27$", color="#b91c1c", fontweight="bold", fontsize=10)
ax_a.text(5.0, 3.6, r"direct $\approx 0$" + "\n" + r"($-0.09$, 95% CI $[-0.31,+0.24]$)",
          ha="center", color="#6b7280", fontsize=9)
ax_a.text(5.0, 1.3, r"Indirect $-0.077$  (95% CI $[-0.17, -0.03]$)" + "\n" +
                    r"$\bf{88\%}$ of S$\to$Shannon effect via CSP1-2",
          ha="center", va="center", color="#92400e", fontsize=9,
          bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", fc="#fef3c7", ec="#92400e", alpha=0.9))
ax_a.set_title("(a) Causal mediation:  salinity → CSP1-2 → Shannon", loc="left", fontsize=10)

# ---------------- (b) Unified intervention forest plot (Bayesian state-space twin) ----------------
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
comps = ["surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"]
comp_color = {"surface": "#d97706", "deep": "#0e7490", "rhizosphere": "#15803d"}
rows = []
# Rainfall dose gradient from non-linear model (Hill, surface): one value per dose
for rain_mm in [5, 10, 20, 30]:
    sub = nonlinear[(nonlinear.model == "Hill") & (nonlinear.compartment == "surface") & (nonlinear.rain_mm == rain_mm)]
    if len(sub):
        r = sub.iloc[0]
        rows.append((f"do(rain +{rain_mm} mm)", "rain", r["median_z"], r["ci_lo_z"], r["ci_hi_z"]))
# Salinity interventions
for tag in [("S -= 1", "do(S −1 SD)"), ("S -= 2", "do(S −2 SD)")]:
    m = interv_ex[interv_ex.intervention.str.contains(tag[0], na=False)]
    # Global average from interv table
for scenario in ["do(S -= 1 SD)", "do(S -1 SD)"]:
    s = interv[interv.intervention == scenario]
    if len(s):
        r = s.iloc[0]
        rows.append(("do(S −1 SD)", "salinity", r["delta_shannon_median_z"], r["delta_ci_lo_z"], r["delta_ci_hi_z"]))
        break
# Reclamation scenario per compartment
rec = interv_ex[interv_ex.intervention.str.contains("S -2 SD.*P \+1", na=False, regex=True)]
if len(rec) == 0:
    rec = interv_ex[interv_ex.intervention.str.contains("S -2", na=False)]
for comp in comps:
    s = rec[rec.compartment == comp]
    if len(s):
        r = s.iloc[0]
        rows.append((f"Reclamation ({comp[:4]})", comp, r["median_z"], r["ci_lo"], r["ci_hi"]))

if rows:
    labels = [r[0] for r in rows]
    vals = np.array([(r[2], r[3], r[4]) for r in rows])
    kind_color = {"rain": "#2563eb", "salinity": "#9ca3af"}
    colors_fp = [kind_color.get(r[1], comp_color.get(r[1], "#6b7280")) for r in rows]
    y = np.arange(len(rows))
    for i, (lo, med, hi, c) in enumerate(zip(vals[:, 1], vals[:, 0], vals[:, 2], colors_fp)):
        ax_b.hlines(i, lo, hi, color=c, lw=3, alpha=0.75)
        ax_b.scatter(med, i, s=140, c=c, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.8, zorder=5,
                     marker="D" if "Reclamation" in labels[i] else "o")
    ax_b.axvline(0, color="k", lw=0.8, alpha=0.4)
    ax_b.set_yticks(y); ax_b.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=8.5)
    ax_b.invert_yaxis()
    ax_b.set_xlabel("Δ Shannon (σ)")
ax_b.set_xlim(-1.2, 0.9)
ax_b.set_title("(b) Interventional posteriors: rainfall, salinity, reclamation\n"
               "     (Bayesian state-space digital twin, 95% CrI)", loc="left", fontsize=10)
ax_b.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax_b.grid(True, axis="x", alpha=0.3)

# ---------------- (c) Non-linear rainfall dose-response (surface) ----------------
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
comp_plot = "surface"
model_colors = {"Hill": "#b91c1c", "Spline": "#0ea5e9", "GP": "#15803d"}
for model, color in model_colors.items():
    sub = nonlinear[(nonlinear.model == model) & (nonlinear.compartment == comp_plot)].sort_values("rain_mm")
    if len(sub) == 0: continue
    ax_c.plot(sub.rain_mm, sub.median_z, color=color, lw=2, label=model)
    ax_c.fill_between(sub.rain_mm, sub.ci_lo_z, sub.ci_hi_z, alpha=0.15, color=color)
ax_c.axhline(0, color="k", lw=0.8, alpha=0.4)
ax_c.axvline(9.5, color="#b91c1c", ls=":", alpha=0.6)
ax_c.text(10, 0.35, "Hill K = 9.5 mm", color="#b91c1c", fontsize=8)
ax_c.set_xlabel("Rainfall over 7 days (mm)")
ax_c.set_ylabel("Δ Shannon (σ, surface)")
ax_c.set_title("(c) Rainfall dose-response: three functional forms\n    consistent at small mm, diverge at >20 mm", loc="left", fontsize=10)
ax_c.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8, frameon=False)
ax_c.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax_c.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# ---------------- (d) JSDM knockout top-affected genera (enlarged) ----------------
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
if knockout is not None and "shift" in knockout.columns:
    name_col = "genus" if "genus" in knockout.columns else knockout.columns[0]
    k = knockout.dropna(subset=[name_col, "shift"]).copy()
    k = k[k[name_col].astype(str) != "nan"]
    k["shift_abs"] = k["shift"].abs()
    k = k.sort_values("shift_abs", ascending=False).head(12)
    fp_colors = ["#b91c1c" if s < 0 else "#1d4ed8" for s in k["shift"]]
    y = np.arange(len(k))
    bars = ax_d.barh(y, k["shift"], color=fp_colors, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.85)
    ax_d.set_yticks(y)
    ax_d.set_yticklabels(k[name_col], fontsize=10)
    ax_d.invert_yaxis()
    ax_d.axvline(0, color="k", lw=0.8, alpha=0.4)
    # annotate bar values
    for rect, v in zip(bars, k["shift"]):
        ax_d.text(v + (0.0003 if v > 0 else -0.0003), rect.get_y() + rect.get_height()/2,
                  f"{v:+.4f}", ha="left" if v > 0 else "right", va="center", fontsize=8)
    ax_d.set_xlabel("Δ mean genus relative abundance after CSP1-2 knockout\n(JSDM with 3 latent factors, 500 posterior draws)")
else:
    ax_d.text(0.5, 0.5, "JSDM knockout detailed shifts not cached",
              ha="center", va="center", transform=ax_d.transAxes)
    ax_d.set_xticks([]); ax_d.set_yticks([])
ax_d.set_title("(d) JSDM knockout: top 12 genera affected by CSP1-2 removal\n"
               "     (propagates to ΔShannon ≈ −0.35 via biotic associations)", loc="left", fontsize=10)
ax_d.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax_d.grid(True, axis="x", alpha=0.3)

out_pdf = FIG / "fig4_digital_twin.pdf"
fig.savefig(out_pdf, bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(FIG / "fig4_digital_twin.png", bbox_inches="tight", dpi=160)
print(f"wrote {out_pdf} ({out_pdf.stat().st_size} bytes)")
plt.show()
```
